text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: multiple kubelet restarts detected in infer-usw across 4 nodes - impacting routing and causing container restarts. Incident ID: INC-2026-04-15-503. Metrics: pod restarts spike, 5xx rate up. Pager: @eng-oncall

Alex: acked. I'm on call, pulling logs.

Mira: I can help with triage. seeing kubelet restart events across nodes infer-usw-2a/2b/3a/3b. NotReady flaps starting ~5043219600.

Sam: Any obvious cause? kernel OOPS or driver?

Mira: quick grep of node syslogs shows repeated watchdog timeouts and GPU driver messages. snippet:

```
[5043219621.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[5043219621.123789] kernel: watchdog: BUG: softlockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s
[5043219630.000001] kubelet: node not ready: network plugin disabled
```

Alex: pods in inference namespace show CrashLoopBackOff and OOMKilled for the runtime container on those nodes. running:

```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
NAME                               READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
model-server-qt-7b-abc123          0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5          12m   infer-usw-2a
model-server-rt-13b-def456         0/1     OOMKilled          3          9m    infer-usw-3b
```

Julie: paging: start triage playbook "kubelet-spike". Short plan: 1) isolate bad nodes (cordon), 2) drain with graceful timeout, 3) route new traffic away, 4) scale warm pool, 5) gather logs and metrics.

Alex: cordoning bad nodes now.

Alex: `kubectl cordon infer-usw-2a infer-usw-2b infer-usw-3a infer-usw-3b` -> done.

Mira: starting drains one by one to avoid big churn. using `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` for model pods.

Sam: rerouting: adjusting smart-routing policy to favor dedicated-burst and fallback-models for the region. Pushing config: route-infer-usw -> weight: dedicated-burst=80%, hosted-fallback=20%.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout triggered for routing-config/reroute-504321 by Sam. (link: https://console.redwood.example/rollouts/504321)

Alex: customers: early telemetry shows customer-facing 5xx spike to 7.8% and median latency +120ms for affected region. Notifying CS/SE.

Julie: posting incident notice to #general-customer-impact and paging account reps for customers with SLA. cc: @sales

Sam: scaling warm pool now: `infractl scale pool warm-infer-usw --replicas 6` -> in progress.

Mira: while drains run, I'm collecting kubelet logs and dmesg. attaching brief extract:

```
# journalctl -u kubelet -n 200
Apr 15 15:34:20 infer-usw-2a kubelet[1234]: E04015 15:34:20 server.go:123] Failed to start container: ErrImagePull
Apr 15 15:34:21 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 9876 (model-runtime) score 145
Apr 15 15:34:22 kubelet[1234]: Node status: NotReady
```

Alex: interesting — evidence of both GPU driver hang (Xid) and OOM. Could be memory leak in runtime when driver resets. We'll treat as combo failure.

Sam: mitigation check: are we able to shift traffic to eu-west/hosted? any cross-region impact?

Mira: cross-region not affected. Only infer-usw cluster nodes in a single AZ. Routing change should mitigate customer impact quickly.

Alex: handoff: I need to step away for 25m to handle a customer call. Sam, you're primary. Julie, you're secondary.

Sam: taking the pager. I'll keep updates here. :thumbsup:

Julie: I'll keep the playbook running and collect logs for postmortem.

ops-bot: autoscaler: warm-infer-usw scaled to 6 replicas (3m). New nodes provisioning ETA ~4m.

Sam: verified traffic shift: error rate down to 2.4% in region after routing change and warm pool up. latency trending back to baseline.

Mira: nodes are restarting kubelet less frequently after drains. I'm leaving one quarantined node uncordoned for diagnostics.

Alex: what next steps for mitigation -> short term: replace suspect nodes, update gpu-driver image, add K8s kubelet guard to restart less aggressively; long term: instrument runtime to detect pre-OOM and fallback to smaller batch sizes.

Sam: creating runbook ticket and incident doc. I'll capture timelines and attach logs.

Julie: notifying infra to start hardware checks on infer-usw nodes and file ticket with cloud provider for PCI bus errors.

Sam: handing off to oncall post-incident review owner @Mira for root cause. I'll keep followups in #postmortems.

Mira: noted. I'll open RCA and schedule. Initial severity: Sev3 -> elevated briefly because customer 5xx spike but no full outage.

Alex: thanks team. closing this live thread; will update if anything flips. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-04-15-503 status -> mitigated. Follow-up: RCA assigned to Mira. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-04-15-503
